pass_b_english: This man, like God, has overcome death. Again, the soldiers guarded him as dead, but the gatekeepers of Hades, seeing him as God, were terrified. You will say that this is the same one, not another and another, not one in another, nor one through another; for the Logos, who became flesh, has united these things in an ineffable way, giving flesh to passions and using divinity for signs and wonders, as it is not fitting to separate the Logos from the flesh, so it is necessary that sufferings be united with wonders. For the one who, like a dead man, descended into Hades, this one, like God, freed the dead, since angels somehow serve as attendants at the tomb, and the women, like brides, appear to them, and they said to them: 'You seek Jesus...'
